name: Save email attachments to Drive and log them in a sheet

parameters.content:
## Save email attachments to Drive
Every new email with an attachment: the files are saved to one Google Drive folder with a tidy name (`2026-11-21_Acme-Ltd_invoice-123.pdf`) and logged as a row in a Google Sheet. Signature logos and other tiny images are skipped.

1. Fill in **Settings** (Drive folder ID, spreadsheet ID)
2. Add the header row to your sheet (see README)
3. Connect Gmail, Google Drive and Google Sheets credentials
4. Send yourself a test email with a PDF, then activate

assignments.name: allowedExtensions
assignments.value: pdf, jpg, jpeg, png, heic, docx, xlsx, csv, xml

nodes.name: Settings
nodes.notes: Fill these in before the first run. The workflow stops with an error while driveFolderId or spreadsheetId still say REPLACE_ME. myAddress only builds the Gmail links in the sheet; savedLabelId is optional.

nodes.name: Label as Saved
nodes.notes: Optional. Must use the same Gmail credential as New Email with Attachment, or Gmail returns 'Requested entity was not found'. Errors here are ignored, so a missing label never stops the workflow.
